newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Alcan eyes Australia bauxite project.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Alcan eyes Australia bauxite project.

text.p: Alcan South Pacific Pty Ltd, the Australian subsidiary of Montreal-based Alcan Aluminium Ltd, said on Wednesday it had made important progress toward the possible opening of a new bauxite mine in Northern Queensland.

Last April, Alcan undertook a feasibility study into developing the Ely bauxite project, located within its its Cape York Peninsula bauxite reserves. Alcan said three important prerequisites for the full project authorisation were on schedule based on a planned annual output of 2.5 million tonnes
The feasibility study, completed at the end of 1996, has confirmed the economic attraction of the project, Alcan said.
Also a draft environmental impact assessment, submitted for government approval in November, shows the project to be an ecologically sustainable, Alcan said.
Moreover, negotiations with the local Aboriginal community were proceeding well and on schedule under a memorandum of understanding agreement, it said.

Alcan said it has approved funding for the next phase, which will pursue environmental and other regulatory approvals, as well as the completion of pre-startup work, including calling tenders and selecting suppliers. It will also seek conclusions of the negotiations with the Aboriginal community.
The company said it expects to receive government clearances for the project in time to meet its proposed fieldwork schedule aimed at a possible start of mining in late 1999.
